input.summary: Reverse Deliverable ownership to Customer with Vendor assignment; Vendor Technology remains with Vendor under 14.3
input.comment: [Playbook] We own the work product we pay for, so we have flipped ownership of Deliverables to Customer with an assignment from Vendor; Vendor Technology stays with Vendor under Section 14.3 and the Section 13.2 perpetual licence. A revocable, term-limited licence to our own bespoke deliverables is not acceptable; if Vendor cannot assign, our fallback is Vendor ownership plus a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable licence to use and modify the Deliverables.

ops.oldText: 14.2 Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: 14.2 Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer, and Vendor hereby irrevocably assigns to Customer all right, title, and interest in each Deliverable upon creation. Vendor retains Vendor Technology in accordance with Section 14.3.
